'''Starks''' was an Imperial pilot within the [[77th Air Wing]]'s [[Sword Squadron (Imperial)|Sword Squadron]]. During the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] in the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], Starks flew under [[Dagger Flight]] under the call-sign of [[Dagger Leader/Legends|Dagger Leader]]. Alongside [[Amp]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shea Hublin]], he was one of the people directly responsible for the destruction of the [[Hypermatter reactor/Legends|hypermatter annihilator]] for the [[Citadel of Axes]]' shield generator, as well as, alongside the aforementioned pilots, [[Dibs]], and [[Rocket (77th Air Wing)|Rocket]], one of the few pilots to survive the battle.
